prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Denver. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Denver for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — to give you the best specific names and phone numbers I need one quick detail: what part of Denver (ZIP code or neighborhood) are you in or want to travel to? Also tell me whether this is for an adult or a child, whether you strongly prefer Invisalign vs traditional braces, and whether you have orthodontic insurance or a budget target.

If you want an immediate checklist while you decide, here’s what I recommend and why — so you can vet any provider I send:

What to look for (and why)
- Board certification/credentials: Look for a DMD/ DDS + orthodontic specialty, and if possible Diplomate of the American Board of Orthodontics. Board certification indicates extra training and standards.
- Invisalign experience level: Invisalign ranks providers (e.g., Diamond/Platinum Elite). Higher tiers mean more cases and more experience with complex aligner cases.
- Technology & diagnostics: 3D intraoral scanner (no goopy impressions), CBCT (when needed), digital treatment simulations — these improve planning and comfort.
- Clear communication of cost & timeline: Ask for a written estimate with total cost, monthly payments, and what’s included (retainers, refinements, x‑rays).
- Follow-up & emergency care: How often appointments are, who to call for emergencies, and what happens if you lose a retainer.
- Treatment approach & options: Some offices favor aligners, others braces, others use accelerated techniques (propel, AcceleDent). Pick the approach you’re comfortable with.
- Reviews and before/after photos: Real patient results and photos for cases similar to yours.
- Insurance / financing: Confirm they accept your plan and ask about in‑office payment plans, 0% financing, or third‑party lenders.

Questions to ask on the phone/at the consult
- Are you board certified? How many years have you practiced?
- How many Invisalign/aligner cases do you treat per year? What is your Invisalign tier?
- Do you use an in‑office 3D scanner? Will I see a digital treatment plan before starting?
- What is the estimated total cost and typical monthly payment? What’s included?
- How often are follow-ups and how are emergencies handled?
- For kids: do you recommend early treatment now or wait until X age?

If you tell me your ZIP/neighborhood, age, and Invisalign preference I’ll return a short list (3–6) of specific Denver orthodontists or practices to call, with phone numbers, addresses, and a one‑sentence reason to call each.
